<subject>GRIDVIEW/NERO AVAILABILITY</subject>
<body>
To all GRIDVIEW users:

The GRIDVIEW system will be brought down on a nightly basis between 00:01 - 04:00 Uhr for nightly processing. The system will be available in the morning after that time, with positions primed by 05:30 Uhr.

NERO will be available during these times.

Please call the GRIDVIEW Hotline (+49 171 373 5700) if you have any questions or concerns.
</body>
